wing_name: Failed Sign-ins, Then a Successful One (Behaviour)
description: At least five failed sign-ins for one account, then a successful interactive sign-in or unlock by the same account within 30 minutes. UBA rules: failed_logon (Security 4625) then interactive_logon / workstation_unlock. A failed sign-in names the account it tried; only accounts with a profile on this computer have a SID, so guesses at names that do not exist here are counted as not evaluated, not dropped. A person who forgot a changed password produces the same sequence.
proves: An account signed in successfully after a run of failed attempts
